title: Career Aspirations
theme: Discussing a Career Change / Job Interview

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: I've been thinking about applying for a new job. I want to work on projects that are more ambitious and challenging.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: That's exciting! The job search process can be arduous, but it's worth it to find the right role.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: I also want to make sure the position is lucrative enough to help me save for a house.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: Of course. Doing tedious tasks all day for a low wage isn't sustainable.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: Exactly. In my new job, I really want more autonomy to make decisions on my own.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: You're very versatile, so I'm sure you could adapt to a lot of different team setups.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: Thanks, Ava. I know I am competent at my work, but interviews always make me feel a bit timorous and nervous.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: Don't let that exacerbate your anxiety. Everyone gets nervous, just focus on your strengths.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: I have some reluctance to leave my current colleagues because they are so nice.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: That's natural. But if you are assiduous in your preparation, you'll land a great new role.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: True. I need to focus on my career progression and long-term goals.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: Let's update your resume tonight and start looking at openings!

vocabulary.meaning: having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed
involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring
producing a great deal of profit or wealth
too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous
the right or condition of self-government; independence to make decisions
able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities
having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully
showing or suffering from nervousness, fear, or a lack of confidence
make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse
unwillingness or disinclination to do something
the process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state

takeaway: Advancing your career requires ambitious goals and assiduous preparation, even if the transition process feels arduous at times.
